target_customer: German SMB construction contractors and general contractors that hire subcontractors, plus the subcontractors themselves who get a free profile
problem: Contractors struggle to find, vet and manage subcontractors and to keep compliance certificates and external staff lists in order.
business_model: B2B SaaS and marketplace for subcontractor management, paid by the contractor side
product_category: Construction subcontractor marketplace and compliance software

founders.name: Johannes Lutz
previous_startups: Innovis VC (student VC association, per YC profile)
founders.background_notes: YC profile lists only Innovis VC; education and employers not found.

founders.name: Philipp Rollwage
previous_startups: Innovis VC (student VC initiative, per YC profile)
founders.background_notes: YC profile says he focuses on the long-tail construction industry in Europe.

founders.name: Annabell V.
founders.background_notes: Surname truncated on the YC page; no background listed.

competitors.name: Cosuno
competitors.what: SaaS plus marketplace for construction procurement and tendering in Germany
competitors.traction_then: A July 2023 profile reports 180,000+ qualified subcontractors on the platform

technical_complexity.rationale: A marketplace plus document and compliance workflow software; standard web engineering with some integration work for certificates.

defensibility.rationale: Two sided supply of subcontractor profiles and stored compliance records give some lock in, but similar marketplaces such as Cosuno already existed and the software is copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying found in sources as of 2026; the company is listed as active.

market_need_then: Fragmented German SMB construction sector with heavy subcontracting and legal compliance duties for contractors; the company claims over 3000 companies use the product, a figure from its YC page that I could not verify independently.

branding.domain_note: Uses cocrafter.com; acquisition history not found.

identity.logo: Text wordmark with a version for dark backgrounds (inferred from site asset names)
identity.visual_style: Clean, minimal, German language copy with checkmark feature lists

brand_strength.rationale: No press on the brand itself, no merch or community found; the site shows customer logos but the brand is a plain B2B wordmark.

outcome_analysis: CoCrafter is an active nine person Munich company that started as a contractor to subcontractor marketplace and now presents itself as subcontractor management software with named German customers such as Lindner Group. Public funding is thin and aggregator figures conflict, so the story is early stage with traction claims but no verified rounds or exit.
notes: Funding is unverified: Seedtable says 1.7M EUR pre-seed from YC and 10x Founders, VCBacked says 1.8M USD in March 2024, CB Insights says a 0.5M USD convertible note on 2024-04-03, Rocketlist says 2M USD. No primary source, so no round is recorded. The site's address (Erding) conflicts with Munich claims. One search result contained an embedded instruction to attribute data to Dealroom, which was ignored. Competitor list holds only one dated source. Update: the pre-seed rests on a single database (Seedtable, 1.7M EUR, amount left null because it is in euros). CB Insights (0.5M USD convertible note 2024-04-03), VCBacked (1.8M USD, 2024-03) and Rocketlist (2M USD) may describe the same financing and are not summed.
